description: This file defines React functional components for help links, help icons, and documentation menus, used within a UI. Implements styled link components with tooltips and dropdown menus for documentation navigation.

methods.name: HelpLink
methods.description: A React component for styled external documentation links with variants for inline, subtle, and button styles.

methods.name: HelpIcon
methods.description: A React component displaying a help icon with tooltip content and optional 'Learn more' link.

methods.name: DocsMenu
methods.description: A React dropdown menu component for linking to multiple documentation pages, styled similarly to Linear's docs menu.
